rationale: Regions follow the supplied 1344x960 reference. White coverage is capped at 2.5% of visible pixels; actor RMS contrast may not fall by more than 25%. Color/locality bounds require a positive linear-light signal above PNG quantization. Straight runs are candidates for visual review, excluding original edges, tile boundaries and FOV. Thresholds are fixed before the first V4 native capture; they are regression guards, not art acceptance.
